description: A Python module for parsing diff/patch files, specifically for WebKit patches, including classes for representing diff files and a parser for diff input.

classes.name: DiffFile
classes.description: Represents a single file in a patch, containing lines with information about added, deleted, or unchanged lines.

classes.name: DiffParser
classes.description: Parses a diff input into a collection of DiffFile objects.

methods.name: added_or_modified_line_numbers
methods.description: Returns a list of line numbers that are added or modified in the diff file.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes a DiffFile with a filename.

methods.name: add_new_line
methods.description: Adds a new line to the diff file.

methods.name: add_deleted_line
methods.description: Adds a deleted line to the diff file.

methods.name: add_unchanged_line
methods.description: Adds an unchanged line to the diff file.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the DiffParser and parses the diff input into diff files.

methods.name: _parse_into_diff_files
methods.description: Internal method that processes the diff input and constructs DiffFile objects.
